title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer

About the Role:
We are seeking a talented Full Stack Software Engineer to build scalable web applications. You will collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to architect modern user interfaces and robust APIs.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Build efficient, secure REST APIs and microservices using Python (FastAPI or Flask) or Express.
- Optimize PostgreSQL and Redis databases for maximum performance and reliability.
- Deploy and manage containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes on AWS or GCP.
- Implement automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
- Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, code reviews, and mentor junior developers.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
- 2+ years of experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks (React, Node.js).
- Hands-on experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching with Redis.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
- Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Job Title: Machine Learning & Data Science Engineer

About the Role:
Apex AI Labs is hiring an AI/ML Engineer to train, evaluate, and deploy predictive models and Generative AI applications.

Key Responsibilities:
- Research, develop, and optimize machine learning and deep learning pipelines using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn.
- Clean and process large datasets using Pandas, NumPy, and SQL.
- Build and fine-tune Large Language Model (LLM) workflows using Hugging Face, LangChain, and RAG architectures.
- Deploy ML models as high-throughput REST APIs using FastAPI and Docker.
- Track experiments and model performance with tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases.
- Collaborate across teams to translate complex business problems into machine learning solutions.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or related technical field.
- Proficiency in Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and SQL.
- Familiarity with NLP, Computer Vision, Transformers, and GenAI techniques.
- Experience with Docker, Git, and Linux environments.
- Strong critical thinking, teamwork, and presentation abilities.

title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

About the Role:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and maintain our enterprise cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
- Manage, scale, and monitor production Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker containers.
- Build resilient CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
- Monitor system health, latency, and uptime using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack.
- Implement security best practices, access management, and vulnerability patching across Linux systems.
- Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery planning.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Administration.
- Deep expertise in AWS (or GCP/Azure), Linux/Unix, and Bash/Shell scripting.
- Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform.
- Familiarity with Python, Go, or Node.js for automation scripts.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and time management skills.

title: Frontend UI/UX Developer
description:
Job Title: Frontend Web Developer

About the Role:
Join our design-focused engineering team to create fast, accessible, and delightful web experiences.

Key Responsibilities:
- Translate Figma designs and wireframes into clean, modular React and Next.js components.
- Utilize Tailwind CSS, HTML5, and CSS3 to craft pixel-perfect, mobile-responsive interfaces.
- Integrate state management using Redux or Zustand and connect with GraphQL / REST APIs.
- Ensure web accessibility (WCAG) and optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) performance.
- Write unit and component tests using Jest and React Testing Library.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- Solid mastery of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Proven experience with React, Next.js, and modern CSS tooling (Tailwind CSS).
- Experience with Git, npm, Postman, and Chrome DevTools.
- Strong aesthetic sense, attention to detail, and collaborative mindset.
